packages/ai/scripts/generate-models.ts.role: Exact OpenAI GPT-6 chat IDs, Standard Responses API, image input, grammar compatibility and reasoning maps

packages/ai/src/models.ts.role: Public clampThinkingLevel respects null effort mappings, including Off

decisions: Standard Responses with SSE; no Codex Lite inference from model names or legacy profiles.
Custom apply_patch uses the existing local grammar and Pi's explicit supportsOpenAIGrammarTools metadata.
view_image is local execution gated by Pi's image-input metadata.
Search, image generation, native compaction, WebSocket prewarm and Fast remain off by default; users may explicitly configure endpoint capabilities and model implementations.
Pi owns model descriptors, reasoning mappings, limits and pricing; the plugin does not register replacement descriptors.
limits: Pinned source/catalog and offline request/activation tests, not real account or endpoint acceptance.
supportsToolSearch and supportsAdditionalTools describe Pi orchestration, not hosted web_search or Codex Lite entitlement.
Existing openai-codex profiles are frozen; no openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol entry is added.
This is a curated exact-ID addition, not coverage of every model in the OpenAI catalog.
